speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Dislocation of the Right Femoral Head.

The classic presentation of a shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated leg following a rear-end collision is highly specific for an anterior hip dislocation. This diagnosis is supported by your severe groin pain and the specific deformity of the right leg, distinguishing it from posterior dislocations or fractures.
